environment_corrections.resolution: Run archprepare and scripts/package/mkdebian before bindeb-pkg.

environment_corrections.problem: Target-only global pkg-config library selection broke the native sign-file link
environment_corrections.resolution: Keep native library resolution for host tools; use cross compiler target library paths.
Install python-is-python3 and export PYTHON=python3, as production CI does.

environment_corrections.problem: BIOS EDD disk probing stalled before kernel console initialization
environment_corrections.resolution: Retain serial/BIOS diagnostics and add edd=off.

environment_corrections.problem: Raw Debian package extraction replaced /lib symlink, hiding the dynamic loader; kernel panicked before executing init
environment_corrections.resolution: Restore Ubuntu usr-merge after extracting the package.

environment_corrections.problem: Exported root filesystem had a regular /dev/console placeholder; guest stdout was not emitted over serial
environment_corrections.resolution: Create a character device and reopen init standard streams after devtmpfs mount.

environment_corrections.problem: Default xz symbol compression processed only about 3.5 GiB in twenty minutes on the bounded builder
environment_corrections.resolution: Default xz and gzip symbol compression were deliberately interrupted. Use KDEB_COMPRESS=gzip and a recorded build-only dpkg-deb wrapper adding -z1. Production resumes the same dpkg-buildpackage binary recipe directly against existing generated metadata; debug continues its bindeb-pkg job. Preserve earlier logs/packages and requalify final image packages.
